Team / Claire —

We're T-8 business days for the April 1 webinar ("Scaling LLM Inference"). I want to lock platform logistics today so we can hand off to Ops for rehearsals. High-level asks below; please reply with confirmations or outstanding blockers.

Checklist (please mark yes/no + short note):
- Primary platform: ON24 event instance ready? (ON24 instance + registration page)
- Fallback: Zoom Webinar configured as hot-standby (RTMP ingest to ON24 if needed)
- Registration form final: fields, GDPR checkbox (consent), recording permission language
- Streaming test: schedule a full stream + panelist run-through (incl. OS/browser matrix) — propose Wed Mar 11 10:00 PST
- Recording handling: confirm who gets master recording, where it's stored (S3 bucket vs ON24 library), retention policy
- Presenter roles: confirm accounts for 3 panelists + 1 moderator (presenter vs panelist rights)
- Access & links: provide ON24 event ID, Zoom webinar ID & passcode, RTMP key (if required) 24h prior

Attachments: registration_form_v1.pdf (draft), ON24-config.txt (current settings).

Claire — can you confirm ON24 ingest supports an RTMP fallback and whether you can provision the RTMP key 24 hours before the event? Also, legal asked us to include an explicit recording consent checkbox on the form; see recording-permission-copy.txt for suggested wording.

If everyone signs off, I'll schedule the Wed test and invite the panelists.

Thanks,

Marissa / Vanessa —

Thanks for looping EventPro in. A few items from our side:

- ON24 RTMP ingest: confirmed. We can accept RTMP to ON24 and will provide the ingest URL + stream key ~24 hours before the event. For rehearsals we can provide a temporary key.
- Presenter handoff: we typically require presenters to be added as "presenters" in ON24 48 hours prior to the event. Please send the list of presenter emails by Fri Mar 26.
- Recording consent language: Legal at our end also recommends explicit opt-IN wording. Suggested copy (we recommend):
  "I consent to be recorded and to receive follow-up communications related to this webinar."
  If you want a shorter option for the form, use: "I agree to be recorded."
- Storage/ownership: EventPro can store a backup recording for 14 days on our servers and then push to your S3 bucket. We will need the destination URL and an IAM role with write access ahead of time.
- RTMP fallback from Zoom: Yes, Zoom can stream to ON24, but we need a test 24 hours before to validate key exchange.

I attached ON24-config.txt with the recommended ingest settings and recording retention notes. Also linking the HubSpot event record: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/event/EVT-8241.

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if you'd like to walk through the test steps.

Best,
